limitations: Original geometry, diffuse textures, source prefab transforms, source skeletons, every animation frame and action markers are retained.
Three.js PBR lighting uses source sun color/intensity and ambient color; it does not reproduce the proprietary uber_pbr shader or unconverted prefab material overrides and particles.
Source team-mask formula is preserved. Exact native client team uniform constants are unavailable; this game supplies its blue/red colors.
Only original SC movieclip billboards are rendered. Shader mesh effects and native material/timeline graphs require a separate renderer.
Particle simulation is a bounded deterministic browser interpretation. Unsupported packed curves and cone/deceleration emitters are omitted.
The LOD1 source variant intentionally does not sample normal maps.
Scene shadowmap and native light-uniform packing are not reproduced. Material overrides are preserved in source metadata.
